offering_description.value: Operates cosmetic and aesthetic medical clinics in Japan that treat individual patients for appearance-related procedures. Patients pay for treatments and related skincare products, delivered in person at the clinics.

primary_services.value: aesthetic surgery; dermatology treatments; injectable treatments; laser treatments

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual patients seeking cosmetic and aesthetic treatments

revenue_model.value: service fees: treatment fees paid by patients for procedures; product sales: skincare products and cosmetics sold at clinics and online

value_chain_position.value: service provider: runs clinics that deliver treatments directly to patients

geography_served.value: global: Japan, with clinics in Tokyo, Osaka and other major Japanese cities

specialization.value: niche specialist: aesthetic and cosmetic clinic treatments only

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated clinics; online: online consultations and product sales

regulatory_exposure.value: high: high: clinics and medical procedures licensed under Japan's Medical Care Act and pharmaceutical and device rules

offering_description.value: Places doctors, nurses and other medical staff with clinics and hospitals in Japan and supports their recruitment. Medical institutions pay placement and staffing fees, delivered through direct sales and online tools.

primary_services.value: medical staffing; recruitment placement; clinic staffing support

customer_segment.value: B2B: clinics and hospitals that hire medical staff

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: placement and staffing fees paid by medical institutions

value_chain_position.value: service provider: recruits and places medical staff with healthcare providers

specialization.value: niche specialist: medical staffing and recruitment only

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales staff contacting clinics and hospitals directly

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: medium: worker placement and employment rules under Japan's Worker Dispatch Act and labor laws

notes: Japan is not among the geography options, so Japan is entered under global; business mix and size are from general knowledge and may be incomplete.
